name: AZCubing Spring 2017

venue.name: Mesa Convention Superstition Ballroom North
venue.details: The Superstition Ballroom is in Building A, on the corner of E 3rd Pl and N Center St

information: The registration fee is $12 for the first event and $2 for each additional event. There is a 75 competitor limit at this event and you must register online. Please note that there is ***no outside food or beverage*** allowed at this venue.
